registration: T-R4 crypto trend, half A, v1
sealed: Strategist draft 2026-10-15; operator approval by running Sprint R4-1 (RUN-IS-APPROVAL)
look_budget: one Stage R registered look drawn forward from the Q1 2027 allowance; Q4 2026's three (T-R1, T-R1b, T-R3) are spent; T-R3b is a confirmation and does not count

data.price: the close of the Binance 1d kline stamped (open_time) on each UTC calendar day; the vintage holds closed days only
data.monthly_price: the close of the kline stamped on the last calendar day of the month; if that kline is absent, the last available close before it INSIDE THE SAME SLEEVE
data.known_omission: JUPUSDT and SYRUPUSDT were excluded at fetch by the leveraged-token suffix clause and are absent from the vintage; recorded, not patched; both books share the omission

universe.name: binance_usdt_top20_pit_halfA
universe.pool: every symbol in the vintage except the exclusions below

exclusions.tokenized_equities_rule: every symbol whose base ends in the letter B and whose first_open_time in the manifest is on or after 2026-06-11; the resolved set must number exactly 95 or HALT

universe.sleeve_split_rule: a symbol's history is cut into separate sleeves at every interior gap of one or more missing calendar days; a sleeve ends with a forced exit to USDT at its last close in BOTH books; no return is ever computed across a gap; each sleeve earns eligibility on its own history
universe.eligibility: a sleeve is eligible at month-end t when it has at least 10 month-end closes (t included) and at least 90 daily bars ending at t
universe.ranking: at each month-end t, eligible sleeves are ranked by the sum of quote_volume over the 90 daily bars ending at t
universe.membership: the top 20 by that ranking; all eligible sleeves when fewer than 20
universe.weights: equal, 1/N_t across the N_t members, set at month-end t, earning in month t+1
universe.survivorship: the vintage holds only symbols listed on the venue at 2026-10-15; delisted coins are absent; both books hold the same survivors, so dSR and dMu are survivorship-neutral to first order; the LEVEL of buy-and-hold return is biased upward and is not adjudicated

books.TREND: each member sleeve holds its coin for the following month when its month-end close is above the mean of its last 10 month-end closes (current month included); otherwise it holds USDT
books.BUY_AND_HOLD: the same weights, always holding the coin
books.cash: USDT at zero yield in both books; any USDT yield forgone is not credited to TREND (conservative)

window.first_scored_month: the month after the first month-end with at least two eligible sleeves; expected 2018-06 (BTC and ETH reach ten month-ends at 2018-05-31); both months are stated in the report
window.first_month_buy_in: the first scored month pays a full 1.0 turnover buy-in in BOTH books (the R3 convention)
window.half_B_earning_months: 2022-01 .. 2024-12, UNOPENED; one registered confirmation look, only on SOMETHING
window.signal_history: month-end closes before the first scored month are signal history only; nothing earns before it

costs.applied_to: both books, on traded notional (state switches, membership changes, rebalancing), aggregated by ASSET: every sleeve in USDT is one USDT position
costs.drift: weights drift with realised returns inside the month; turnover is measured between the drifted weights and the next month's targets; cost is charged to the month the new positions earn; cost is not compounded into the drift
costs.adjudication: base costs adjudicate; stress is reported

statistic.sharpe: annualised Sharpe of monthly returns, mean/std * sqrt(12), std ddof=1; cash yield is zero so raw returns are excess returns
statistic.dSR: Sharpe(TREND NET) minus Sharpe(BUY_AND_HOLD NET) over the same months; the statistic the null votes on
statistic.dMu: annualised arithmetic mean monthly return (mean * 12) of TREND NET minus BUY_AND_HOLD NET; the materiality bar, not a test
statistic.descriptives: invested share k, number of state switches, turnover per book, max drawdown per book, N_t path; reported, not adjudicated

voting_null.name: random-timing books (two-state Markov at the book-under-test's own measured rates); the R3 null unchanged
voting_null.rates: per sleeve, p01 and p10 estimated from the state path of the book under test over consecutive months in which the sleeve is a member; initial state drawn from the implied stationary distribution
voting_null.degenerate_rates: n0 == 0 -> p01 = 1.0; n1 == 0 -> p10 = 0.0; p01 + p10 == 0 -> stationary set to the empirical mean state
voting_null.p: the share of random books with dSR >= the dSR of the book under test
voting_null.what_it_asks: whether the rule times better than chance AT THE SAME CASH LEVEL AND TURNOVER
voting_null.second_null: none at half A; a block-bootstrap premium null is added to the half-B confirmation if half A promotes

order_of_operations: 1. STATE PATH AND RATES: the rule's state path on half A is computed only to measure switching rates (frequency, not performance); no performance figure of the observed book is computed or printed before step 5
2. MDE: the dSR detectable at 80% power from the random books' spread, (null p95 - null median) + 0.8416 * sd(null dSR); printed before anything else
3. KNOWN-NULL CONTROL: 200 random-timing books fed in as the observed book, each against a fresh 500-book null; the share at p <= 0.05 must lie in [0.01, 0.10] or HALT

4. POSITIVE CONTROL: semi-synthetic on the real half-A data; each member sleeve's state set to the sign of its next-month return with probability q and the opposite otherwise; q calibrated on ONE draw so dSR is about 0.5; then 50 fresh draws; detection at p <= 0.05 must be >= 0.80 or HALT
5. OBSERVED: only then, and only on a pass receipt from steps 3 and 4

positive_control.leak: DELIBERATE and named by a test: the planted state reads the sign of the return it is about to earn

controls.q_target_rationale: a Sharpe lift of 0.5 is the smallest effect worth acting on in a spot long-only basket; R3 targeted 0.4 on about 125 months; half A here has about 43, so the positive control is also the power test

halts.known_null_outside_band: HALT before the observed read; no look spent; no ledger row
halts.positive_control_below_floor: HALT before the observed read; no look spent; no ledger row; the design returns to the Strategist because the window cannot see an effect of the registered size
halts.return_computed_across_a_gap: HALT, asserted in code and pinned by a test

verdict.SOMETHING: timing p <= 0.05 AND dSR > 0 AND dMu >= 0 at base costs -> promoted to one registered half-B look (2022-2024)
verdict.RISK_ONLY: timing p <= 0.05 AND dSR > 0 AND dMu < 0 -> recorded as risk reduction without return (the R3 class); not promoted; a nil for discovery
verdict.SUGGESTIVE: p in (0.05, 0.10] with dSR > 0 -> recorded, not promoted

interpretation_rulings.ruling: above means strictly greater; equality holds USDT
states are decided at month-end t and earn in month t+1; the first scored month is the first RETURN month; both months are stated
weights drift with realised returns inside the month; turnover is measured between the drifted weights and the next month's target weights; cost is charged to the month the new positions earn
a sleeve leaving the top 20 at month-end t is sold at its month-end close in both books; the turnover is charged to month t+1
a sleeve entering the membership at month-end t takes the TREND state computed on its own history at t
a sleeve that ends (gap or vintage end) is sold at its last close in both books; the month's return runs to that close
